title: Supervised learning, risk and generalisation
description: Learning as minimising empirical risk over a hypothesis class; true risk versus training error; why a held-out set estimates generalisation and under which assumptions (i.i.d. data, independence from model selection).

title: Data leakage
description: Ways evaluation data can influence a fitted model other than through the training set: target leakage, preprocessing fitted on all data, duplicates, temporal and group leakage, selection on the test set; why a high metric under leakage is not evidence.

title: Baselines, seeds and the uncertainty of a metric
description: Trivial and simple baselines, base rates, random seeds and run-to-run variance, the sampling error of an accuracy estimate, and what a reported number must be accompanied by to count as evidence.

title: Tensors and automatic differentiation
description: Multidimensional arrays with shapes, dtypes and devices; the computational graph recorded during a forward pass; reverse-mode automatic differentiation, gradient accumulation and the training loop.

title: Gradient descent
description: The gradient as the direction of steepest ascent; the gradient descent iteration; step-size conditions and convergence rate on quadratics and smooth functions; conditioning.

title: Backpropagation as the chain rule on a computational graph
description: Adjoints propagated in reverse topological order; cost of reverse versus forward mode; hand computation of gradients through small networks.

title: Multilayer perceptrons
description: Affine maps composed with nonlinearities; universal approximation (statement and limits); depth versus width; classification with cross-entropy; initialisation.

title: Learning dynamics of deep linear networks
description: Gradient flow in deep linear networks analysed through the singular value decomposition of the input–output map; stage-like learning; representational similarity; illusory correlations during training.

title: Optimisation methods for deep networks
description: Poor conditioning and momentum, mini-batch stochastic gradients and their cost–variance trade-off, adaptive methods such as RMSprop and Adam, non-convex landscapes and overparameterisation.

title: Overfitting, memorisation and early stopping
description: Train/validation/test curves, overparameterised networks fitting random labels, validation-based early stopping as implicit regularisation.

title: Regularisation in deep learning
description: L1 and L2 penalties as shrinkage, dropout, data augmentation, the learning rate and batch size as regularisers, hyperparameter search and its perils.

title: Convolution as a linear operator
description: Discrete convolution and cross-correlation as linear, translation-equivariant maps; kernels, padding, stride and output size; pooling; parameter sharing and parameter counts versus fully connected layers.

title: Attention and transformers
description: Queries, keys and values; scaled dot-product and multi-head attention; positional encoding; the transformer block; sequence models and language-model pretraining.

title: Generative and self-supervised representation learning
description: Learning representations without labels: generative models, self-supervised objectives, and how learned representations are evaluated.
